g.title: scope
g.text: ADVANCE markers return to the selected walker; they are control exits, not extra hardware.
CE-low holds local state; system SDRAM, host and scanout continue independently.
D24 stays separate from perspective division. Keyed depth-only draws must sample.
Cache hit: 14 unit edges + 1 parent capture. System misses add dynamic waits and native slot reads.
Only the blocks adapter uses a fixed 34-edge miss + 1 parent capture.
Tile cycles INCLUDE texture-memory waits during Draw; exclude record fetch / tile DMA waits.
System last_pass_cycles includes record fetch, tile DMA, rendering and shared-memory delays.
System storage: 29 native BSRAM =12 original +12 client-slot +2 reader +3 row banks.
CPU transforms / clipping / triangle setup / binning remain external. Arrows do not imply 1 pixel / cycle.

g.title: trace
g.text: Accepted token ID / retired token ID may differ on the same edge
Commit, depth rejection, key rejection or reset cancellation
Stage / enable / in-flight counts; common-clock mapping in system mode
Fixed scoreboard; CSV traces / cadence / latency / consecutive-run checks
No extra GPU state, ports or cycles
